rows.grounds: compound member denoting the boundlessness of power; first member of a compound qualifying pramukhaṃ
adjective indicating what stands foremost or is included among other things
name of the work or teaching; source in which the stated topics are prominent
compound adjective qualifying sadyukteḥ, indicating origin in authoritative scripture

items.question: What additional topics, prominent in the scripture-born Sadyukti, follow the account of impurity?
premises: The true nature of impurity has already been fully stated.
Infinity of power and related topics are foremost.
These topics are prominent in Sadyukti.
items.inference: Therefore, topics such as the infinity of power, as presented in the scripture-born Sadyukti, are included beyond the completed account of impurity.
uncertainties: The exact scope of what is included under pramukhaṃ is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Beginning with the infinity of power, these topics are prominent in the Sadyukti, which arises from scripture.
